avis.texte: I wore mine for 2 hours. It didn't get completely transparent so I probably could have worn it longer. It did get transparent in some spots. I washed my face AND added a light moisturizer before applying. At first, the mask wanted to slide around so I needed to lie on my back. After the first hour, it stayed in place better as I moved around. It's a nice spa experience. I just layed back and relaxed. My skin was soooo hydrated and bouncy at the end of the 2 hours. I'm 44 and my fine lines were plumped in. My skin type is sensitive combination skin that can get extremely oily in my t-zone but extremely dry on my cheeks and outer forehead. I have a weekly routine of using a enzymatic rice powder peel to remove excess dead skin. I like to use a jelly sheet mask over moisturizer afterwards to help calm my skin after the exfoliator treatment. This did an amazing job. I was concerned about the mild citrus fragrance but it did not aggravate my skin.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again!
avis.texte: This mask left my skin feeling plump and moisturized. I will definitely be repurchasing again. I have fine lines and some wrinkles and it definitely helped plump and fill them some.

avis.titre: Fell apart when I took it out of the package
avis.texte: I've never had a face mask have rips and tears in it, and fall apart…
I personally love the application and it felt so moisturized at the end! My skin has a great plump after taking it off. I would pair this with a collagen sleep mask for long lasting results.
This face mask is great, but it's made for smaller face shape. The eyes are not cut out for almond shaped eyes. It's unfortunate because it feels super hydrating on the face. I won't be repurchasing.

I wanted to try the mask and I was a little skeptical because it was only four dollars but it was extremely hydrating, skin tightening and left my skin glowing. I'm definitely gonna be buying these in bulk and using one at least once a week because of the price!
Absolutely love this mask! Unlike others I've tried, it doesn't break easily. I applied toner and left it on overnight, and I woke up with glowing skin.
